description: Usage statistics for one database. `kind` selects the series: size (storage used) or cpu (query load).

databaseId.description: Database id, as returned by ws_db_list.

hostingId.description: Hosting id or uuid the database belongs to.

userId.description: Account id, or the literal "self" for the authenticated account. Defaults to "self".

name: ws_db_stats
title: Database statistics
